crossRefs.note: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
“The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me?…
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…

translations.web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
translations.bsb: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
translations.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
translations.asv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
